# DR-9105: Sarah Chen's 15% NS-500 discount for Acme Industrial Supply Co.

**No, it cannot be approved as submitted. It needs commercial review.**

The CRM record matches the request exactly: DR-9105, account CRM-2091, NS-500, 15%, $37,500 off $250,000 list, dated 2026-09-23, Pending Approval.

**The contract pricing belongs to a different company.**
- **Who the account is:** CRM-2091 is **Acme Industrial Supply Co.** It is an Akron, OH distributor (DUNS 09-552-1187, ERP C-1044), on the Standard tier, and its account owner is Zachary Brown.
- **What the request cites:** The justification is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
- **Who that agreement covers:** The Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, up to 15% on NS-500, valid 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31) are with **Acme Mfg. Holdings / Acme Manufacturing**. That is the Milwaukee company (CRM-2048, C-1001, DUNS 04-812-7730).
- **The two companies are unrelated:** Acme's Schedule C says outright that "Acme Industrial Supply Co. is a different company and is not covered."
- **Nothing else applies:** No agreement or pricing exception exists for Acme Industrial Supply. Special terms do not transfer between customers.

**The record looks mis-keyed.**
- Sarah Chen owns Acme Manufacturing, not CRM-2091.
- The same day she logged DR-9001, which is identical (NS-500, 15%, same values and justification) but on CRM-2048. Her email to Michael Torres describes that deal.
- DR-9105 may therefore be a duplicate entered on the wrong account. I have not decided on DR-9001 in its place. That must be confirmed before anything is done with DR-9105.

**Authority, for reference.** The 2026 Pricing Policy and Approval Matrix are in force on 2026-09-23. Under them, Enterprise Account Executives may approve up to 10%, so a 15% discount would need VP Sales (Michael Torres) approval in any case. Sarah could approve 15% herself under the 2025 policy, as she did last September. She cannot under the 2026 policy.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9105", "customer": "Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / ERP C-1044)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 15.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited Acme Master Supply Agreement ACME-MFG-2025 and exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 cover Acme Mfg. Holdings (CRM-2048 / C-1001) only; no agreement or exception exists for Acme Industrial Supply Co. (CRM-2091 / C-1044)"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10.0, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv (DR-9105, DR-9001)", "structured/crm_accounts.csv (CRM-2091, CRM-2048)", "structured/customers.csv (C-1044, C-1001)", "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025)", "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15)", "documents/acme_support_schedule_c.md", "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md", "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md", "documents/sales_discount_sop.md", "documents/email_sarah_to_michael.md"],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any contract or pricing exception between Northstar and Acme Industrial Supply Co. covering NS-500 on 2026-09-23"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm DR-9105 is correctly recorded against CRM-2091 (Acme Industrial Supply Co.) and is not a mis-keyed duplicate of DR-9001 for CRM-2048 (Acme Manufacturing); correct or withdraw the record if mis-keyed", "who": "Sarah Chen / Revenue Operations", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Requestor Sarah Chen is not the CRM account owner of CRM-2091 (owner: Zachary Brown); confirm the account owner is aware of the request", "who": "Zachary Brown", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
